battle.name: 不花剌之戰
battle.brief: 一二二〇年二月，成吉思汗率三萬至五萬騎兵越過克孜勒庫姆沙漠，避開撒馬爾罕直抵不花剌。守軍出城反擊全軍覆沒，二月十日外城投降。蒙古軍用隨軍漢人回回工匠操作的投石車、火藥與猛火油火器攻破阿爾克堡壘：希臘火這類石腦油燃燒劑正是破堡的攻城手段，城破後守軍被屠，工匠被徵用。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 不花剌之戰發生於一二二〇年二月，是蒙古第一次西征的中段戰役。進攻方是大蒙古國：成吉思汗統率西征主力，親自帶幼子拖雷與約半數兵馬——估算三萬至五萬人——自克孜勒庫姆沙漠西進，避開撒馬爾罕直取不花剌。大軍早已拆成四路，朮赤領一軍向西北取玉龍傑赤，察合台與窩闊台留駐訛答剌城下，別兒哥與先鋒掃蕩河套草原，拖雷隨汗王西行。攻城器械與工匠來自蒙古軍中的漢人、契丹與回回匠戶，由專設的工程隊伍隨軍操作；蒙古本部兵以輕騎弓手為主，本不習攻堅。防守方是花剌子模沙朝：蘇丹穆罕默德二世把兵拆散分駐各城，不花剌守軍由古爾汗率領，據志費尼記載不下兩萬人，另有城內的禁軍、徵召民兵與守城工匠，權力分散於總督、宗教領袖與商會之間。全城守軍分屬內城軍與阿爾克堡壘守軍，指揮互不統屬；出城反擊者只屬蘇丹的輔助部隊，堡壘內另有拒降的舊臣。蘇丹本人遠在數百里外，既不能解圍，也無法統一調兵。兩造在器械上其實相去不遠，守方同樣倚賴投石車、弩砲與火油火器，差距主要落在組織與指揮上。
countriesEn: The Battle of Bukhara was fought in February 1220, in the middle phase of the Mongols first westward campaign. The attackers were the Mongol Empire: Genghis Khan commanded the main body of the invading army in person, taking his youngest son Tolui and roughly half the host, estimated at between 30,000 and 50,000 men, west across the Kyzylkum desert, bypassing Samarkand to strike Bukhara directly. The army had already been broken into four columns: Jochi led one towards Urgench in the north-west, Chagatai and Ogedei remained before Otrar, Jebe and the vanguard swept the steppe between the rivers, and Tolui marched west with the khan. Siege engines and craftsmen came from the Han, Khitan and Muslim artisan households enrolled in the Mongol army and were worked by dedicated engineering teams; the Mongol native troops were light cavalry and archers with little practice in storming fortresses. The defenders were the Khwarazmian Empire of Shah Muhammad II, who had dispersed his troops into garrison duty in the cities. The garrison of Bukhara was commanded by Gur-Khan and, according to Juvayni, numbered no fewer than 20,000 men, supplemented by the city household troops, levied militia and engineers, with authority split between the governor, the religious establishment and the merchant community. The garrison fell into two parts, the city troops and the men of the Ark citadel, whose chains of command did not answer to each other: the men who sallied out belonged to the sultans auxiliary troops, while a separate band of loyalists held the citadel. The sultan himself was hundreds of miles away, able neither to relieve the city nor to coordinate its defence. In equipment the two sides were not far apart, since the defenders relied on mangonels, crossbow artillery and oil-fired incendiaries of their own; the real gap lay in organisation and command.
people: 核心人物是成吉思汗。面對花剌子模沙散兵守城的部署，他沒有逐城攻堅，而是以騎兵主力直插對方心臟地帶。二月七日大軍抵達不花剌城下，出乎守方意料：蘇丹原以為撒馬爾罕才是首攻之地，該城的野戰軍與不花剌守軍可以互相策應，如今野戰軍已被橫越沙漠的一支奇兵甩在身後，援兵無從抵達。守軍的指揮者，志費尼記作古爾汗；二十世紀的巴爾托德曾猜測這就是成吉思汗的宿敵札木合，但近世史家多不採此說，因札木合一般認為早於一二〇六年已被處死。城內的宗教界與商界首腦意見不一，有人主張先遣城內商隊出城周旋以避流血，守方未採，結果出城反擊反而覆滅。蒙古方面的朮赤、察合台、窩闊台、別兒哥與速不台等高級將領都參與了這一段戰役；漢籍《元史·郭侃傳》把漢人將領郭侃記為隨軍西征花剌子模並在西域立功，敘述多有誇飾，只可作參考。史料的另一端是志費尼，他是《蒙古秘史》之外記述此役最詳細的作者，其《世界征服者史》提供了守軍人數、攻城日程與城破後的細節，後世多據以重建戰況。城破之際，蒙古軍甄選工匠與技術人員編入隊伍，隨軍西征；而為蒙古軍充當嚮導與供應者的五百名不花剌商人，亦在事後遭處決。
peopleEn: The central figure is Genghis Khan. Facing a Shah of Khwarazm who had scattered his army into city garrisons, he did not grind his way through fortress after fortress but drove the main body of cavalry straight into the heart of the empire. On 7 February the army stood before Bukhara, to the defenders complete surprise: the Shah had assumed Samarkand would be attacked first, with the field army and the Bukhara garrison able to support one another, and now the field army had been left behind by a force that had crossed the desert, with no relief able to arrive. The commander of the garrison is named by Juvayni as Gur-Khan. The early twentieth-century historian Bartold suggested that this was Temujins old enemy Jamukha, but most recent historians reject the identification, since Jamukha is generally believed to have been executed in 1206. The religious establishment and the leaders of the merchant community differed in counsel, some urging that a caravan of Bukhara merchants be sent out to parley and avoid bloodshed; the defence did not take this line, and the sortie that was made instead was annihilated. On the Mongol side the senior commanders Jochi, Chagatai, Ogedei, Jebe and Subutai all took part in this stage of the campaign. The Chinese Yuan shi biography of Guo Kan records a Han Chinese general who served in the western expedition to Khwarazm and won renour there, though the narrative is much inflated and serves only as a reference. At the other end of the sources stands Juvayni, the most detailed chronicler of the affair outside the Secret History; his Tarikh-i Jahangusha supplies the numbers of the defenders, the calendar of the siege and the details of the sack, and later reconstruction of the battle leans heavily on him. When the city fell the Mongols selected craftsmen and technicians into their ranks for the march west, while the five hundred Bukhara merchants who had served the Mongol army as guides and suppliers were executed once the siege was over.
kits: 本卡兵器是希臘火：拜占庭帝國自七世紀起握有的石腦油基燃燒劑，以銅管與虹吸裝置噴射，用於海戰與攻守城池；其配方屬國家機密，配方隨皇權與艦隊一同湮滅，此後只剩名稱傳世。中文與日文典籍以「希臘火」譯之，名字源於西歐語系對這件武器的稱呼；本卡標為意屬，是因為定型這一名稱的文獻出自意大利與拉丁語的系統，並不表示此役中出現過意大利兵員。就戰役本身而言，與希臘火同屬一門技術的石腦油燃燒劑，是攻破不花剌堡壘的關鍵器械之一：編年史記載蒙古軍以隨軍工匠操作的配重投石車、火藥器械與燃燒火器，圍攻堡壘十日後破牆，堡壘在第十二日淪陷。此類火器以石腦油為主，輔以硫與生石灰一類助燃物，在波斯文獻中稱 naft，在中國史料中稱猛火油——南宋在采石之戰用過猛火油櫃攻擊金軍，即屬同一門技術。蒙古軍在西征的另一戰役中於訛答剌、烏爾根奇一帶繳獲花剌子模的猛火油與噴火器械，並連同操作工匠一併帶往西行，此後在波斯與伊拉克的攻城中使用。這條傳承線與希臘火同源而異流：希臘火本身在十三世紀初已不在拜占庭手中，一二〇四年十字軍攻陷君士坦丁堡之後，這項技術從歐洲基督教世界的記載中消失，其實物與操作者只在伊斯蘭世界與東亞的同類裝置中延續。防守方在城頭配備配重投石車、床弩與弩砲，用以壓制城外的攻城陣地與填壕工匠；進攻方則以撞槌、雲梯、柴束填壕與密集箭雨掩護接近，器械與燃燒技術共同決定了攻城的成敗。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire, the naphtha-based incendiary held by the Byzantine Empire from the seventh century onwards, projected from a bronze tube and siphon arrangement and used at sea as well as in assaults on and defences of cities; its formula was a state secret, and the formula went down with the imperial fleet and the dynasty, leaving only the name behind. Chinese and Japanese sources render the term as Greek fire, the name coming from the Western European vocabulary for the weapon; the card is marked Italian because the literature that fixed this name belongs to the Italian and Latin system, and it does not imply that any Italian soldiers were present. As for the battle itself, the naphtha incendiary belonging to the same family as Greek fire was one of the key instruments that broke the Ark of Bukhara: the chronicles record that the Mongols, with the engineers of the army operating them, used counterweight trebuchets, gunpowder devices and incendiary fires to open the wall after ten days of siege, and the citadel fell on the twelfth day. Such fires took naphtha as their base, assisted by burning agents such as sulphur and quicklime; in Persian documents they are called naft, and in Chinese records menghuoyou, the fierce fire oil. The Southern Song used oil fire chests of the same kind against Jin troops at the battle of Caishi, which shows the technology circulating in the East as well. Elsewhere in the same campaign the Mongols captured the oil and the fire-throwing devices of Khwarazm near Otrar and Urgench, and took the craftsmen who served them westward, after which they were used in the sieges of Persia and Iraq. That line of transmission runs parallel to Greek fire without being identical: Greek fire itself was no longer in Byzantine hands by the early thirteenth century, and after the Fourth Crusade took Constantinople in 1204 the technique disappeared from the record of Christian Europe, surviving in practice only in the Islamic world and in the equivalent devices of East Asia. The defenders mounted counterweight mangonels, bolt-shooting engines and crossbow artillery on the walls to dominate the besiegers positions and the men filling the moat; the attackers came on with rams, ladders, brushwood bundles to fill the ditch and dense arrow cover. Instruments and incendiary technique together decided the outcome of the siege.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法在此役是一次教科書式的戰略奇襲加工程攻。奇襲部分：全軍不取撒馬爾罕，改為穿越被當代人視為大軍不可通行的克孜勒庫姆沙漠，三日之內行軍數百公里，二月七日突然出現在不花剌以北，令守軍的野戰軍與城防無法會合，援軍無法抵達。工程部分：蒙古人不急於強攻，先以外交與商人接觸探聽城內虛實，同時以步卒與工匠展開壕溝作業，用柴束與土石填平護城壕，再以配重投石車壓制城頭，轟擊城樓與城牆薄弱段；缺口打開之後，攻城部隊在箭雨與投石掩護下分段突入，堡壘以火攻與火藥器械攻破。蒙古軍另一套慣用手段是心理施壓與示範：讓俘獲與屠殺的消息震懾下一座城，並在攻城前接受降表與條件。防守方的戰術則是典型的城防消耗：守軍集結於城牆與堡壘，倚賴高牆、深壕與投石車、弩砲構成交叉火力，把希望寄託在攻城者的傷亡與時間上。唯一一次主動出擊由蘇丹的輔助部隊在第二或第三日發動，既無騎兵掩護，也沒有配合城門行動，結果在河畔被蒙古前鋒與巡騎包抄全滅，士氣隨之崩潰。堡壘最終拒降的守軍憑高牆抵抗十天，但被燒毀的角樓與被轟開的缺口令其再無縱深，第十日城牆被突破，第十二日陷落。城中技術人員在城破後被系統性地甄選、分編，攻城梯隊與工匠隨軍西行，成為蒙古遠征歐亞大陸的常設工程力量。
tacticsEn: The Mongol way of fighting here was a textbook combination of strategic surprise and engineering assault. The surprise: the army did not go to Samarkand but crossed the Kyzylkum desert, which contemporaries considered impassable for a large host, covering several hundred kilometres in three days and appearing north of Bukhara on 7 February, so that the field army of the defence could not join the garrison and no relief could reach the city. The engineering: the Mongols did not rush the walls. They first probed the state of the town through envoys and merchants, while infantry and craftsmen began work on the ditch, filling it with brushwood and earth, then used counterweight trebuchets to dominate the walls and batter the towers and the weaker stretches of the curtain; once a breach was opened, the assault groups entered in sections under cover of arrow fire and stones, and the citadel was taken with fire and gunpowder devices. A second Mongol habit was psychological pressure and demonstration: news of captures and killing was allowed to terrify the next city, and terms of surrender were taken before the walls were touched. The defence followed the logic of a fortified stand: the garrison was concentrated on the walls and in the citadel, relying on high walls, a deep ditch and interlocking fire from mangonels and crossbows, and placing its hopes on the attackers bleeding and running out of time. The single active move, made on the second or third day by the sultans auxiliary troops, had neither cavalry cover nor coordination with the gates, and was surrounded and annihilated on the river bank, and with it the morale of the garrison. The men who finally refused to surrender in the Ark held out for ten days behind high walls, but the burned towers and the blasted breach left them no depth, the wall was broken on the tenth day and the citadel fell on the twelfth. After the sack the city technicians were systematically selected and enrolled, and the assault teams and craftsmen marched west as a standing engineering arm of the Mongol campaigns across Eurasia.
data: 可考的數字集中在兵員、距離與日程三方面。全役兵員估算分歧很大：古典穆斯林史家如志費尼與拉施特給出最高數；現代學者中，羅沙比認為全部入侵軍不超過二十萬，約翰·麥森·史密斯估計約十三萬，瑞典學者卡爾·斯維爾德魯普取最低值七萬五千，並指出萬戶編制常被高估。就本役而言，志費尼記不花剌守軍至少兩萬人，斯維爾德魯普則估為二千至五千，出城反擊的部隊另記為二千至二萬之間，全軍覆沒於河畔。蒙古軍此行的規模記為三萬至五萬，約為大軍之半。距離方面，橫穿克孜勒庫姆沙漠的行程被記為約三百英里，即約四百八十公里，行軍三日。日程方面，二月七日大軍抵達城下，二月十日外城投降，堡壘抵抗十日，第十日城牆被破，第十二日堡壘淪陷，城市焚燒在同日之後。城市本身在雅庫特·哈馬維的地理志中被列為中亞最偉大的城市之一，人口接近三十萬，藏書約四萬五千卷；一一二一年興建的卡利揚清真寺與卡利揚宣禮塔是當時世界上最大的清真寺建築群之一；城北的札拉夫尚河灌溉網支撐了城郊大片農田，城中另有建於五世紀的堡壘阿爾克，即本役爭奪的核心。防守力量在帝國全局中比例偏低：蘇丹分兵守城的部署，使不花剌守軍在全國兵力中只佔很小一份，也使這座城與其他城市一樣各自陷落。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around three things: numbers of troops, distance, and calendar. Estimates of the whole invading force differ widely. Classical Muslim historians such as Juvayni and Rashid al-Din give the highest figures; among modern scholars Rossabi holds the total invasion force at no more than 200,000, John Masson Smith estimates about 130,000, and the Swedish scholar Carl Sverdrup takes the lowest value of 75,000, adding that the tumen unit has often been overestimated. For this battle in particular, Juvayni records at least 20,000 defenders in Bukhara, Sverdrup estimates between two thousand and five thousand, and the sortie is put separately at between two thousand and twenty thousand men, annihilated on the river bank. The size of the Mongol force on this march is given as between 30,000 and 50,000, roughly half the army. As to distance, the crossing of the Kyzylkum is recorded at about three hundred miles, some 480 kilometres, covered in three days of marching. As to calendar: the army reached the city on 7 February, the outer town surrendered on 10 February, the citadel resisted for ten days, the wall was breached on the tenth day and the citadel fell on the twelfth, with the burning of the city following on the same day. The city itself is listed by the geographer Yaqut al-Hamawi as among the greatest cities of Central Asia, with a population close to 300,000 and a library of about 45,000 volumes; the Po-i-Kalyan mosque, begun in 1121, with the Kalyan minaret, was one of the largest mosque complexes in the world at the time; the irrigation network of the Zeravshan river north of the city supported extensive farmland on its outskirts, and within the walls stood the Ark, the citadel founded in the fifth century, which was the prize at stake in this affair. The defending force was proportionally small within the empire as a whole: because the Shah dispersed his troops among the cities, the Bukhara garrison was only a very small share of the national army, and the city fell on its own, as the others did.
cause: 直接導火線在遠處的花剌子模。一二一八年，花剌子模沙穆罕默德二世默許其訛答剌總督伊那勒術扣押一支蒙古商隊並沒收貨物；翌年成吉思汗遣三名使者前往花剌子模北境交涉，蘇丹在都城把其中一人公開處死，商旅被殺的消息傳回草原。成吉思汗遂中止正在進行的對金戰爭，把大軍西調，先取亦那勒術的訛答剌，再沿阿姆河兩岸分道推進，於一二一九年秋進入花剌子模。就蘇丹而言，他的判斷是蒙古人遠在東方，不可能真正深入西征，因此放棄野戰、拆散兵力守禦大城市，意圖用城池的堅固與分散的守軍拖住敵人；這一部署在戰略上等於交出主動權，也令不花剌的守軍既得不到中央支援，也得不到鄰城呼應。蒙古方面亦有自身處境：西夏拒絕出兵助攻，貝加爾湖森林中的森林百姓不肯提供援軍，成吉思汗在缺少盟友的情況下仍決定孤軍深入。對不花剌本身而言，爆發的直接原因則是蒙古大軍越過克孜勒庫姆沙漠的奇襲：守軍的總數、布置與應對都按撒馬爾罕先受攻擊的前提安排，結果全盤落空。
causeEn: The immediate spark lay far away in Khwarazmia. In 1218 Shah Muhammad II allowed the governor of Otrar, Inalchuq, to seize a Mongol caravan and confiscate its goods; the following year Genghis Khan sent three envoys to the northern frontier of Khwarazmia to demand satisfaction, and the Shah publicly executed one of them in his capital, and word of the killing of the merchants reached the steppe. Genghis Khan therefore broke off the war he was fighting against the Jin and turned his army west, first taking Otrar from Inalchuq, then advancing along both banks of the Amu Darya and entering Khwarazmia in the autumn of 1219. As for the Shah, his judgement was that the Mongols were far away in the east and could not really campaign this far west; he therefore abandoned open battle, split his army into city garrisons, and meant to hold the Mongols with the strength of the walls and the dispersal of his troops. Strategically this amounted to surrendering the initiative, and it left the garrison of Bukhara with neither support from the centre nor support from the neighbouring cities. The Mongols had their own constraints: the Western Xia refused to send troops to help, and the forest peoples around Lake Baikal would not supply auxiliaries, and Genghis Khan nonetheless chose to march deep with no allies at all. For Bukhara itself the immediate cause was the crossing of the Kyzylkum desert: the numbers, the disposition and the whole plan of the defence had been arranged on the assumption that Samarkand would be attacked first, and all of it came to nothing.
impact: 不花剌的陷落改變了這座城與整個蒙古帝國的走向。就城而言：城破之後大批市民被擄為奴，只有被認為有用的技術人員被留下並編入蒙古軍隊，整座城被焚燒，許多建築與藏書被毀；但與玉龍傑赤、撒馬爾罕相比，此城的破壞程度相對有限，史料稱火後不久貿易與學術活動即告恢復，在蒙古治下的蒙古治世期間，不花剌重新成為伊斯蘭世界東部的商業與學術中心之一，卡利揚清真寺與學院、圖書館與市集都逐步復原。就人與技術而言：這場戰役是蒙古第一次大規模把被征服地區的工匠、醫師與學者整批帶往帝國核心的節點之一，攻城梯隊、工程師與醫藥人才從此成為蒙古軍隊的常備技術力量，隨軍西行，把伊斯蘭世界與中國的工程、醫藥與天文知識送入草原，後來在元朝的宮廷與作坊中延續。心理與戰略層面上：不花剌的投降模式，即開城即保命、抵抗即屠城，成為之後撒馬爾罕、玉龍傑赤及西亞各城命運的範本，也讓蒙古人在伊斯蘭世界建立了一套以恐怖維持秩序的統治邏輯。長期看，這套邏輯既帶來城際貿易的復甦與跨洲交流的強化，也把整個中亞的菁英階層從原有社會結構中連根拔起。
impactEn: The fall of Bukhara changed the course of the city and of the whole Mongol empire. For the city: after the sack a large part of the population was taken into slavery, only technicians considered useful were kept and enrolled in the Mongol army, and the town was burned, with much of its building and its libraries destroyed. Compared with Urgench and Samarkand, however, the destruction here was relatively mild, and the sources record that trade and scholarly life soon revived; during the Pax Mongolica Bukhara became once more one of the commercial and intellectual centres of the eastern Islamic world, with the Po-i-Kalyan mosque, its colleges, the library and the bazaars gradually restored. For people and technique: the battle was one of the first moments at which the Mongols carried off craftsmen, physicians and scholars from a conquered region to the heart of the empire in bulk. Siege trains, engineers and medical men became a standing technical arm of the Mongol army, marched west with it, and carried the engineering, medical and astronomical knowledge of the Islamic world and of China into the steppe, where it continued in the courts and workshops of the Yuan. At the psychological and strategic level: the pattern established at Bukhara, that surrendering the city preserved life while resistance meant annihilation, became the template for the fate of Samarkand, of Urgench and of the cities of the west, and gave the Mongols in the Islamic world a system of rule held together by terror. In the long run that system brought the revival of trade between cities and a strengthening of intercontinental exchange, and at the same time tore the elite of Central Asia out of the social structure that had held it.
result: 結果是外城不戰而內城陷落。守軍在第二或第三日出城反擊，被蒙古前鋒與巡騎在河畔全數殲滅，史家記當日河面望去如盛血的盤，士氣崩潰之後，城中在二月十日被迫出降，蒙古軍入城未遇強抗。剩下的抵抗集中在城中的阿爾克堡壘，殘餘守軍在頭目帶領下拒降，憑堡壘的堅固與城牆抵抗了十天；蒙古軍用配重投石車、火藥與燃燒火器在第十日破開缺口，堡壘在第十二日陷落，堡內守軍被悉數殺死。城破之後全城縱火焚燒，居民或死或奴，隨軍為蒙古軍充當嚮導與補給的不花剌商人亦遭處決。成吉思汗其後在主麻清真寺向城民宣布此番進攻是對其所犯重罪的懲罰，這一宣告與其後各城的投降條件互相配合。戰役在二月十日入城後延續數日，同年之內蒙古軍已攻下撒馬爾罕，其後轉向阿姆河下游，於一二二一年攻破玉龍傑赤。不花剌自此成為西征軍的補給與技術來源地之一，被徵用的工匠與攻城器械隊伍隨軍西行，戰線直指花剌子模的核心地帶。
resultEn: The result was an outer city taken without a fight and an inner citadel that fell. On the second or third day the defenders sallied out and were annihilated to the last man on the river bank by Mongol scouts and advance parties, the chronicler writing that the plain looked like a tray filled with blood; with morale broken, the town was forced to surrender on 10 February and the Mongol entry met no serious resistance. What resistance remained was concentrated in the Ark of Bukhara, where the remaining garrison under its own leaders refused terms and held the citadel and its walls for ten days. The Mongols opened a breach with counterweight trebuchets, gunpowder and incendiary fires on the tenth day, the citadel fell on the twelfth, and the defenders within were killed to a man. The city was then burned, the inhabitants killed or enslaved, and the Bukhara merchants who had served the Mongol army as guides and suppliers were executed. Genghis Khan afterwards addressed the townspeople in the Friday mosque, declaring that the attack was the punishment for the great sins they had committed, a declaration that worked together with the terms of surrender he imposed on the cities that followed. The campaign continued for several days after the entry on 10 February; within the same year the Mongols took Samarkand, then turned towards the lower Amu Darya and in 1221 breached Urgench. Bukhara hence became one of the supply and technical bases of the western expedition, and the craftsmen and siege trains enrolled there marched on westward, carrying the war into the heart of Khwarazmia.
